title: About Flash Procession Through Connector Skin
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1209 recent saved-signal files and 318 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @100o111: Cropped face from stock photo titled “woman smashing laptop with hammer.” Made out of... and YouTube Music Library, plus 7 more. A source image from img.youtube.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Flash Procession Through Connector Skin: Product-photo rupture in shallow macro: a vast bead-blasted Apple-silver connector skin, its cropped-face silhouette readable only through pressure, spacing, and thousands of dark USB-C mouths. Two broad aluminum planes collide under hard off-axis flash; oversized chamfered sockets, diagonal bass ridges, dropout sli... After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against large diagonal brushed-metal ridge, black oval connector mouths with polished rims, and upper-right pinhole bead cluster.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
